title: Asymptotic QMA-OTP rate region with general Eve side information
summary: Characterize the asymptotic quantum multiple-access one-time-pad rate region without requiring Eve's side information to be a subsystem of the receiver's.

formal_statement.body: For the source's quantum multiple-access one-time-pad task with senders $A_1,\ldots,A_Z$, receiver side information $B$, and arbitrary correlated eavesdropper side information $E$, remove the assumption that $E$ is a subsystem of the receiver's side information. Characterize exactly the closure of rate tuples $(R_1,\ldots,R_Z)$ achievable from independent copies of the shared state with vanishing decoding error and secrecy error, by proving matching direct and converse bounds for every sender subset.

scope.domain: Asymptotic quantum multiple-access one-time-pad protocols with unrestricted correlated eavesdropper side information
assumptions: Multiple senders apply local encoders and transmit their systems to the receiver
Reliability and secrecy are measured by the source's asymptotic vanishing-error criteria
Eve's initial side information may be arbitrary and need not be contained in the receiver system
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected forward citation provides matching asymptotic direct and converse bounds for the complete arbitrary-Eve QMA-OTP model. One-shot inner bounds and source-coding results solve different predicates.

progress.summary: The source leaves open an asymptotic rate-region characterization when Eve's side information is not necessarily contained in the receiver system.
